window_boundary_rule: half-open [start,end), select actual stored timestamp rows
integration: trapezoid over actual raw time values; no interpolation, resampling, smoothing, or scaling

junction_metrics.calculation: unwrap each JJ phase trace independently; endpoint delta rad and same-JJ/same-row V integral; report residual

waveform_lobe_candidates.method: local signed extrema on raw samples
waveform_lobe_candidates.threshold_reference: positive max for positive lobes and absolute negative min for negative lobes within each half-open channel/window
waveform_lobe_candidates.meaning: descriptive waveform lobes only; not SFQ/event count and not a success threshold

paired_condition_comparison.interpretation: report arithmetic deltas and direct waveforms; final scientific interpretation is reserved for user and ChatGPT
